# calc-site

Student-facing documents for **Combined Calculus (Block 6)** — the finished lecture
documents, packets, entry tickets and one-pagers, plus the unit guides.

**This repository is generated. Do not edit anything here by hand.**
Everything is produced by `admin/pwa/deploy.py` in the private authoring repo; a fix
belongs there and gets republished. Hand edits are overwritten without warning.

Course materials © Ryan Campbell. No textbook content is reproduced here.
